meta.intent: sprite sheet of 6 assets for a military tower defence game
priorities: six separate assets on flat magenta, one per cell
same view angle, scale logic and style for all

frame.layout: sprite sheet, 3 columns x 2 rows, equal invisible cells

panels.asset: cannon tower: round armoured turret on a square sandbag-and-steel base, one thick short barrel pointing up-right, hazard stripes on the base
laser tower: compact dome turret on the same square base type, a long slim emitter barrel with cyan glowing coils and a cyan lens tip, pointing up-right
missile launcher tower: same base type, a box launcher with 2x2 tubes angled up-right, all four tubes loaded, each showing a red missile tip
single missile projectile, horizontal pointing right, olive body, red tip, small fins, short orange-yellow exhaust flame

enemy quadcopter drone: X-frame with four rotors drawn as OPAQUE light-grey motion-blur discs with darker blade streaks (solid paint, not see-through), small camera pod with red lens, grey-purple enemy colours, facing left

enemy fixed-wing drone: small straight-wing UAV, clear V-tail (two tail fins in a V), pusher propeller at the back drawn as an OPAQUE light-grey blur disc (not see-through), grey-purple enemy colours, red sensor dome, flying left

style.medium: 2D game art, hand-painted cartoon with clean vector-like shapes
style.line: bold 3px dark gunmetal outline around every object, thinner inner lines for panels
style.shading: two-tone cel shading, light from top-left, one hard shadow tone plus one small highlight
style.texture: almost none; a few rivets, panel seams and stencil-like hazard stripes
style.detail_level: low to medium: chunky readable silhouettes that read at 64-128px
style.proportions: slightly chunky and toy-like: oversized barrels and bases, rounded corners
style.mood: playful but military, clean and readable

asset.view: top-down three-quarter (camera tilted about 30 degrees from vertical), same angle for every asset
asset.background: perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta everywhere, identical in the corners; no gradient, no ground, no cast shadows; nothing semi-transparent over the background (no glows, smoke or see-through parts)
asset.grid: each asset centred in its own cell with generous empty margin; nothing touches or overlaps a cell edge
asset.size_px: each asset fills about 70% of its cell
